bikeReasons.incomplete_link: Link is missing a code or native ID
bikeReasons.missing_native: Stored ID missing from the BIKETREK catalog
bikeReasons.changed_identity: BIKETREK code or parent differs from the link

title: Atomer migration status
scope: Each sellable Atomer code, its inventory card and links in both shops. xTrek status covers catalog identity and linking. Content and quantities are checked separately.

states.needs_both: No confirmed card or xTrek match

emptySource: Upload buyers.xml for the first check. Later checks can reuse the saved export.

errors.failed: The check failed. Reload the overview.
errors.remote_read_failed: The complete xTrek catalog could not be verified. The last completed result is displayed.
errors.refresh_in_progress: Another check is running. Reload the page when it completes.

reasons.duplicate_source: Different source rows share a code.
reasons.target_claimed: Multiple Atomer codes claim this xTrek listing.
reasons.kind_differs: A variant matches a standalone product.
reasons.parent_differs: More than one parent product matches this family.
reasons.occupied_parameters: Another xTrek listing occupies these parameters.
reasons.different_shop_link: The card already has a different xTrek link.
reasons.link_identity_differs: The existing link has a different code or parent.
